title: SB825 (2023 Regular): Public Safety – Handgun Permits – Expiration and Renewal Periods for Retired Law Enforcement Officer

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2023RS/bills/sb/sb0825f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader: the bill as filed. No passage vote in the record.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5–309(e)): A PERMIT ISSUED TO A RETIRED LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER WHO RETIRED IN GOOD STANDING FROM SERVICE WITH A LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY OF THE STATE OR A COUNTY OR MUNICIPAL CORPORATION OF THE STATE: (1) EXPIRES ON THE LAST DAY OF THE HOLDER’S BIRTH MONTH FOLLOWING 7 YEARS AFTER THE DATE THE PERMIT IS ISSUED; AND (2) SUBJECT TO SUBSECTION (C) OF THIS SECTION, MAY BE RENEWED FOR SUCCESSIVE PERIODS OF 5 YEARS EACH IF, AT THE TIME OF AN APPLICATION FOR RENEWAL, THE APPLICANT POSSESSES THE QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE ISSUANCE OF A PERMIT.
